ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The diagram below represents a food web. What is a food for frog?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a food web, with a plant labeled “plant” at the top. Below the plant there are two blue arrows, one of which points from plant to the frog image on the right labeled “poison dart.” Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate the direction of energy flow, that is, from the food being eaten to the organism that eats it. Because the arrow points from plant to the frog, the frog’s food is plant.
